outcome.technical: run-test-gate.py: new section 'last round's reds, ahead of a task's re-gate'. last_task_row(rows, phase, task) = the task's newest recorded run (no base, no --full), read through measured_row for a repeat. red_first_stage(rows, manifest, phase, task, tree) -> (stage, lines): for each red step of that run (not the pre-gate), a red-first step of a previous stopped run is re-run verbatim under its own name; any other is narrowed by _red_suites_of through the base-run readers (_declared_suites_at_base, _derived_at_base, _joined_at_base), skipped with a printed reason when the runner named no suite, the list was cut, a suite is no file of the tree, the row keeps a digest, or the step is not the bare recorded spelling (it runs in its place in the gate rather than twice on a green). Names are RED_FIRST_PREFIX ('red-first/') + the narrowing's name (_red_first_name lists suites for a plain declared name). red_first_or_why reads the ledger fail-open. run_gate(red_first=...) runs the stage after the pre-gate and before the gate; any stage step not green (pre_gate_stops) stops the gate: later steps are not_run_step with basis RED_FIRST_NOT_RUN and stoppedBy the first red stage step; a red pre-gate stops the stage too. A stage that ran whole and green is removed from steps/step_named/step_text and returned as res['redFirst'] ([] otherwise), so counts, verdict and the declared gate the binding reads are the gate's. main: stage only for --task, not --own, on a measured run (prior None); a stage clears a part repeat (printed line) so the green path is measured; stage commands are published (kept verbatim) in _record_run. drive-phase.py: base_need's kept/elsewhere sentences now take their runs from kept_base_runs (whole-step base_row_for run for a step answered by name; per-suite suite_base_run per named suite for a declared step answered suite by suite - the rule base_unmeasured uses), named by runs_named ('run X' / 'runs X, Y' / 'a run recording no id' / 'no run this ledger names'); stale compares the reading with the newest run; elsewhere fires only when no run was measured for this red and names each run's baseOf. Single-run text is byte-identical to before.
